# INI fixtures

`speeduino_202501.ini` is `reference/speeduino.ini` of https://github.com/speeduino/speeduino at
tag `202501.1` (commit 88ed249d0d255fce3093272f24cadbf6de6e099a), unmodified (GPL-2.0, like the
Speeduino firmware). It matches the embedded base tunes with signature `speeduino 202501` and is
used by `tests/test_basetune.c`.
